doc: A FULL OpenFold3 training step on the card, timed by part.

env.aiclk_line: CLOCK: dev0 min 800 / median 1350 / max 1350 MHz over 127 samples, polled DURING the work

config.rng: diffusion noise and loss fixture drawn from SEPARATE streams, so a chunked arm and an unchunked one noise the same structures

capture.trunk_forward_note: the shipped call, progress_fn INCLUDED and cold; the timed arms below drop it

diffusion.noise_draw: whole sample axis, drawn before any chunking, indexed by replicate
diffusion.rep_atom_index: first atom of each token, from atom_to_token_idx
diffusion.per_sample_s_basis: measured per replicate at width 1; the batch wall divided by its width above 1

bond.skipped: weight is zero in this stage

losses.scope: token, one representative atom per token
losses.shape: model: per-replicate terms per root, head terms once per step

reps.cut: si_trunk + zij_pad + 27 cache entries (84 taped tensors) -> detached leaves
